text_block_list.text:
Prevailing over the fierce competition to 
shine in 1st place at the Arima Kinen was 
none other than Haru Urara!

However, Haru Urara felt frustrated, 
saying she didn't feel like she was 
running under her own power and had no 
fun.

Having a strong desire to run with even 
more joy in the Arima Kinen, Haru Urara 
declares that she will run in the Arima 
Kinen once again.
